questions.prompt: You augment training images for a left-arrow versus right-arrow sign classifier. Which augmentation is NOT label-preserving?
options: Random crop that keeps the whole arrow
questions.explanation: A mirrored left arrow is a right arrow.

questions.prompt: 5,000 frames come from 20 video recordings. A random 80/20 frame split gives 99% test accuracy. What is the main problem?
options: The test set is too large relative to training, so accuracy is overestimated
The images are too small, so the classifier can only learn lighting differences
Near-duplicate frames from the same recording land in both train and test (leakage)
Accuracy cannot be computed on video frames because they are not independent images
questions.explanation: Split by recording, day or location instead.
